**Who is it for?** This game is built for children roughly 4-8 years old.
An idea that makes it better for a grown-up and worse for a five-year-old
is the wrong idea — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

**Could it hurt anybody?** Outside of ⚔ Attack! and battle mode the world
is safe, deliberately. Anything that changes that needs to say why.
